newsitem.title: USA: Willis Lease files for, prices IPO.
newsitem.headline: Willis Lease files for, prices IPO.

text.p: Willis Lease Finance Corp said on Tuesday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for its proposed initial public offering of two million new shares of common stock.
The offering will be made through an underwriting group managed by Wedbush Morgan Securities and Dain Bosworth Inc.

The offering is expected in mid-September in the price range of $8 to $10 per share. Following the offering, Willis Lease Finance expects its stock to trade on the Nasdaq National Market System under the symbol WLFC.
Willis Lease Finance provides operating leases of spare commercial aircraft engines worldwide to commercial airlines, aircraft manufacturers and repair facilities.
